question: Where are Knights of the Old Republic save files stored on Windows?
answer:
On Windows, KOTOR save games live under your user profile in the game's Saves folder (typically under Documents or the Steam/GOG install path depending on edition) [1]. Back up the whole Saves directory before modding or transferring profiles between machines [2].

[1] https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Star_Wars:_Knights_of_the_Old_Republic
